answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is reputation-based proof-of-stake, where agents stake valuable digital assets, akin to a pearl of great worth, to participate in validation. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would face a gale of increasing costs, as each onyx node would require a separate, costly stake. This deters Sybil attacks, as the cost of creating fake identities exceeds potential gains.
